readings.text: make a cat jump between rooftops and catch a fish before it slides into the gutter.
a dog has to grab a ball and escape from a farmer without getting caught.
let a rabbit sneak past a fox to steal a carrot from the garden.
a horse races a tractor down a muddy lane with shortcuts through the field.
a cow balances a milk bottle on its head while walking over a wobbly bridge.
a pig rolls a pumpkin uphill while a wolf tries to knock it loose.
a sheep has to dodge a lawn mower while finding the opening in a fence.
make a goat carry a cabbage up a mountain without dropping it off the edge.
a chicken chases a worm around the yard while avoiding a hungry cat.
a duck pushes an egg across a pond while a crocodile circles closer.
a mouse drags a cheese wedge through a kitchen while a cat patrols the floor.
a rat rides a skateboard through a drain and jumps whenever the water gets too deep.
a squirrel catches an acorn bouncing down a tree before it reaches the ground.
a fox sneaks around a sleeping dog to reach the other side of a barn.
a wolf races a deer through the woods and has to jump over fallen branches.
a bear protects a honey jar from a bee by moving it between hiding spots.
a frog jumps between lily pads to catch a fly that keeps changing direction.
a turtle carries a strawberry across a busy garden without letting it roll off its shell.
a fish swims through narrow gaps in a reef to escape a shark.
a shark races a speedboat around an island and can cut underneath the dock.
a dolphin keeps a beach ball in the air while swimming through floating hoops.
a penguin slides downhill after a fish while a seal tries to get there first.
an owl delivers a letter through a forest without touching any branches.
an eagle dodges a helicopter while flying through a canyon with barely any room.
a bee carries a flower back home while a spider blocks the shortest route.
a butterfly escapes a bird by flying through tiny openings in a greenhouse.
an ant pushes a sugar cube over a picnic blanket without falling into the folds.
a spider swings under a table and catches a cookie crumb before it hits the floor.
a snake dodges a rolling bowling ball inside a twisting tunnel that keeps getting narrower.
a monkey swings across a river to grab a banana hanging above the water.
a farmer chases a runaway pig through a field without stepping on the crops.
a chef flips a pancake higher each time and has to catch it while the kitchen floor tilts.
a firefighter uses a hose to push a zombie away from the station door.
a doctor carries a medicine bottle through a hospital corridor with a slippery floor.
a nurse catches a falling bandage before it rolls under a moving hospital bed.
a builder places a brick on a wobbling stack that gets taller after every successful drop.
a painter uses a paintbrush to cover moving targets before they disappear behind a wall.
a teacher protects a book from a ghost by sliding it between desks.
a student sneaks past a robot to deliver a backpack to the classroom.
a delivery driver carries a pizza across a courtyard while a dog gives chase.
an astronaut catches a floating wrench while bouncing between tiny planets with different gravity.
a pirate grabs a coin from a sinking deck while a skeleton blocks the stairs.
a knight fights a dragon using a shield that can bounce fire back.
a wizard uses a wand to freeze a giant spider long enough to escape.
a robot carries a battery through a factory where the conveyor belts keep reversing.
a helicopter lifts a rescue basket from a rooftop while weaving between swinging cranes.
a pangolin curls into a ball and races an armadillo down a spiral ramp.
a quokka carries a sandwich through a campsite while a goose tries to steal it.
an okapi weaves between moving trees to deliver a mango before sunset.
a binturong balances a teacup on its tail while climbing across a shaky rope.
a fossa chases a lemur through treetops where every branch bends under its weight.
an aye-aye taps a coconut at the right moment to bounce it up a staircase.
a tarsier leaps between swinging lanterns to catch a moth before dawn.
a saiga races a dust devil across a salt flat and hides behind rocks when it gets close.
a takin pushes a barrel up snowy steps while an avalanche chases it.
a gerenuk stretches to grab an apple while balancing on a slowly spinning platform.
a numbat sneaks past a monitor lizard to carry a biscuit into its burrow.
a bilby digs through soft sand to find a bell before its tunnel collapses.
a quoll jumps across kitchen shelves while a broom sweeps after it.
a tenrec rolls a lime through a maze made from giant shoelaces.
a solenodon carries a candle through a cave and has to keep the flame away from dripping water.
a colugo glides between towers to snatch a ribbon blowing around in the wind.
a kinkajou swings a bucket under a leaking pipe and catches every drop before time runs out.
a coati steals a doughnut from a picnic while a raccoon tries to intercept it.
a dhole races a jackal through a bamboo maze with gates that keep switching places.
a shoebill catches a rubber duck popping out of different holes in a floating board.
a kakapo waddles through a museum carrying a gem while a security drone searches overhead.
a kea steals a spoon and slides down a snowy roof before a caretaker notices.
a hoatzin climbs through a flooded tree to rescue a hat drifting toward a waterfall.
a potoo freezes whenever a hawk looks its way and moves closer whenever the hawk turns around.
a secretary bird kicks a football through moving gates while a mongoose tries to block each shot.
a cassowary charges through a fruit market after a runaway watermelon without hitting the stalls.
a sunbittern opens its wings at the right moment to scare a crocodile away from a nest.
a jacana carries a cherry over sinking lily pads while a catfish bumps them from below.
an olm follows echoes through a dark underwater maze to find a ring.
a tuatara guards a crystal from a centipede by turning mirrors around a tiny temple.
a gharial races an otter along a canal where the current keeps changing direction.
a mata mata hides under leaves and catches a grape whenever it drifts close enough.
a leafy seadragon sneaks past a lionfish by staying still whenever the seaweed stops moving.
an oarfish threads through a sunken ship to pull a necklace out of a locked cabin.
